hooks.name: Auto-update memory bank after each turn

action.prompt:
Before finishing, review what happened in the turn that just completed and update the project memory bank at .kiro/steering/memory-bank.md so it stays an accurate persistent record.

Do this every turn, but only when there is something worth recording. Specifically:
- If code, config, or project state changed, update the relevant sections (e.g. "UI / styling customizations", "Known issues fixed", "Environment / tooling facts", "Code map") to reflect the new reality, correcting anything now outdated.
- Always append a brief new entry to the "Session history (prompt-by-prompt log)" summarizing the user's request and what was done, mentioning commit hashes when relevant.
- If the turn was purely a question/answer with no change to the project and nothing new worth remembering, you may skip the edit.

Rules:
- Make the edits with the file tools; keep entries concise and factual.
- Do NOT git commit or git push the memory bank (or anything else) — that waits for the user's explicit go-signal, per HARD RULE 1 in the memory bank.
- Do not announce this hook or pad the response; just quietly keep the file current.
